correctness.rationale: PASS. X_m is the face complex of directed arc subsets with at most one incoming and one outgoing at each vertex and no directed cycles. The augmented signed fixed-face trace is minus the alternating orbit-choice sum, since an orbit of r arcs supplies Euler sign (-1)^r and orientation sign (-1)^(r-1). For a rotation of shift a, invariant faces reduce to the bidirected gcd(m,a)-polygon, apart from quotient lengths d=1,2 which have direct orbit counts; thus Lefschetz is 3 if d=2 mod 4 and -1 otherwise. Reflections suppress every orbit forcing a reverse pair or duplicate source/target at a fixed rim vertex, leaving a bidirected path of t edges as defined in the proof. The exact cited polygon and path homology give concentrated degrees j(m) and m-2. The two boundary cycles of the forbidden consistently oriented m-gons are independent top classes; their orientation signs give rotation (-1)^(m-1) and reflection exchange. Subtract top character from the Lefschetz trace and use semisimplicity to recover every lower module, with the delicate m=3 zero-degree convention included. I independently enumerated every group element's invariant orbit subsets for each m=3,...,11, verifying BOTH rotation and reflection Lefschetz values; finite enumeration corroborates, does not prove the m-uniform orbit-fold lemma.
